Select IC50 activity records for the parent compound CHEMBL3182437 and all its salt forms against target CHEMBL3430885. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from the parent molregno to retrieve all related forms. For each compound, retrieve activity provenance via the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical_smiles. Filter for activities where standard_type is IC50 and target chembl_id is CHEMBL3430885. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
